heading: Plan freeze status
detailsHelp: This status is read when the page loads or when you refresh it. It does not update live.
waitingHelp: The deadline has passed. No project baseline has been saved yet.
preparingHelp: Registered meeting occurrences still need preparation before the baseline can be saved.
calendarSummary: Meetings still to prepare: {{missingCount}}. Issues to resolve: {{blockedCount}}.
moreBlockers: Additional blockers are not included in this response. Review the calendar and refresh status.

automation.not_configured: Automatic freeze has not been enabled for this period.
automation.enabled: Automatic freeze is enabled for this period.
automation.revoked: Automatic freeze is turned off for this period.

automationHelp: When enabled, the original project plan can be saved automatically after its deadline. Turning this off keeps deadline protection when plans are edited. Calculate reports separately when you need them.
pausedHelp: Pausing advance meeting creation does not cancel registered occurrences. Preparing missing meetings still needs current calendar authorization.
requestScheduled: Processing requested for no earlier than {{time}}.
confirmed: Request confirmed. The current status is checked again.
pending: A cutoff action is being saved. Its original period and settings are retained.
unknown: A cutoff action is unconfirmed. Its original period and settings are retained.

blocker.automation_not_configured: Enable automatic freeze for this period or save its baseline manually.
blocker.cutoff_grant_revoked: Automatic freeze was turned off. An administrator can enable it again.
blocker.cutoff_grant_stale: The automatic-freeze authorization changed. Refresh status before requesting processing.
blocker.cutoff_authorizer_inactive: The person who authorized automatic freeze is no longer active. Renew authorization.
blocker.cutoff_authorizer_capability_revoked: The person who authorized automatic freeze no longer has permission. Renew authorization.
blocker.authorization_missing: Recurring meetings need generation authorization before missing occurrences can be prepared.
blocker.authorizer_inactive: A recurring-meeting authorizer is no longer active. Review that series authorization.
blocker.authorizer_capability_revoked: A recurring-meeting authorizer no longer has permission. Review that series authorization.
blocker.authorization_revision_stale: A recurring-meeting authorization changed. Review the series and refresh status.
blocker.cross_period_conflict: A meeting occurrence conflicts with another period. Review the recurring meeting.
blocker.candidate_limit_exceeded: The recurring-meeting calendar exceeds the supported preparation limit. Review the series.
blocker.source_unavailable: A required calendar source is unavailable. Review the series and refresh status.
blocker.unsupported_event_version: A calendar-processing request is unsupported. Ask an administrator to review it.
